m: स—काश m. See s.v.
स-काश mfn. having appearance or visibility, visible, present, near, L.

स-काश m. presence, propinquity, vicinity, nearness (used in the sense of a preposition, esp. after verbs of motion, such as ‘to go, come’, &c., with a gen. [or rarely abl.] of a person, or ifc. ; e.g. सकाशम्, ‘to, towards, near’; सकाशे, ‘in the presence of, before’; सकाशात् or ˚शतस्, ‘from the presence of, from’; आ सकाशात्, ‘as far as, up to’ [the fire]), ŚrS.; Up.; MBh. &c.
a: सकाश — a. Having appearance, visible, present, near. --शः Presence, vicinity, nearness. (सकाशम् and सकाशात् are used adverbially in the sense of {1} near. {2} from near, from, from the presence of).

m: स—काकोल mfn. together with the hell Kākola, Mn. iv, 89.
a: सकाकोलः — N. of one of the 21 hells; see Ms. 4. 89.

m: स—काली f. See s.v.
सकाली f. N. of a place, Cat.
सकाली—समुद्र ib.
स—काल mfn. seasonable, ib.
a: सकाल — a. Seasonable, opportune. --लं ind. Seasonably, betimes, early in the morning.

m: स—कालम् ind. seasonably, betimes, early in the morning, ib.
स—का˚मारि m. ‘enemy of lovers’, N. of Śiva, MW.

m: स—काम (स), mf(आ)n. satisfying desires, VS.; R.
having one's wishes fulfilled, satisfied, contented, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
consenting, willing (said of a girl), Viṣṇ.; Mn.; Yājñ.
(ifc.) wishing, desirous of Śiś.
acting on purpose or with free will, Tithyād.
full of love, loving, a lover, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
betraying love (as speech), Pañcat.
a: सकाम — a. 1 Full of love, impassioned, loving. --2 Lustful, amorous. --3 One who has got his desired object, satisfied, contented; काम इदानीं सकामो भवत् Ś. 4; किमन्यत् सकामा कपालकुंडला Māl. 9. --मं ind. 1 With pleasure. --2 Contentedly. --3 Assuredly, indeed.

m: स—कामम् (अम्), ind. with pleasure, for the pl˚ of (acc.), Divyāv.

SaktivIjaM parAtparam । kowividyullatAkAraM kuRqalItrayasayutam । paYcadevamayaM devi! paYcapARAtmakaM sadA । rajaHsattvatamoyuktaM tribindusahitaM sadA” kAmaDenuta॰ । tasyADizWAtfdevatArUpaM yaTA “SuklAmbarAM SuklavarRAM dviBujAM raktalIcanAm । SvetacandanaliptANgI muktAhAropaSABitAm । ganDarvagoyamAnAYca sadAnandamayIM parAm । azwasidDipradAM nityAM BaktAnandavivardDinIm । evaM DyAtvA sakArantu tanmantraM daSaDA japet” varRodDArata॰ asya vAcakaSabdAH “sAhaMsaH suyaSA vizRurBfgvISaScandrasaMjYakaH । jagadvIjaM SaktinAmA sohaM veSavatI BfguH । prakftirISvaraH SudDaH praBA SvetA kulojvalaH । dakzapAdo'mftaM brAhmI paramAtmA paro'kzayaH । surUpA ca guReSo gOH kalakaRWo vfkAdarI । prARAdyA ca parA devI lAkzmIH somo hiraRyapU । durgottAraRasammohA jIvo mUrttirmanoharaH” varRABiDA॰ । mAtfkAnyAme 'sya dakzapAda nyAsyatA । kAvyAdo prayoge PalaM suKam “saH sOKyaM hastu svaMdam” vf॰ ra॰ wI॰ । zopadeSaDAtUnAM prayAge dantyAditvam “sakArajaH zakAraScetyukteH sati nimitte punaH zatvam ।
m: 1. स—कार m. the sound or letter स्, Prāt.
2. स—कार m. id.
3. स—कार mfn. (for 1. and 2. See p. 1111) active, energetic, Śiś. xix, 17.

= next, W.

a cheat, deceiver, Kathās.
a: सकैतव — a. Deceitful, fraudulent. --वः A cheat, rogue.

स—कीट mf(आ)n. full of worms &c., Hcat.
स—कौरव mfn. along with the Kauravas, VarBṛS.
स—कौतूहलम् ind. eagerly, with curiosity, Śak.
स—कौतुक mf(आ)n. full of expectation, expectant of, eager for (comp.; अम् ind.), Ratnāv.; Kathās.
स—कौतुकम् ind.
सक्थी See under सक्थि.
सक्थ (ifc.) = prec. (cf. अञ्जि-, अपर-, उत्तर-स्˚ &c.)

a: सक्थन् — A substitute for सक्थि after acc. dual

s: [n] klI, (sajyate iti । sanja saNge + “asisaYjiByAM kTin .” uRA॰ 3 । 154 । kTin .) UruH । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA, mArkaRqeye । 18 । 49 । “nfRAM pade sTitA lakzmIrnilayaM saMprayacCati । sakTnoSca saMsTitA vastraM taTA nAnAviDaM vasu ॥”) SakawAvayavaviSezaH । ityuRAdikozaH ॥

m: सक्थि n. (derivation doubtful; the base सक्थन् [fr. which acc. pl. सक्थानि, RV. v, 61, 3] appears in later language only in the weakest cases, e.g. sg. instr. सक्थ्ना gen. abl. सक्थ्नस् loc. सक्थनि, or सक्थ्नि cf. Pāṇ. vii, 1, 75; there occurs also nom. acc. du. सक्थ्यौ [RV. x, 86, 16; AV. vi, 9, 1] formed fr. a fem. base सक्थी), the thigh, thigh-bone
the pole or shafts of a cart (du. euphemistically ‘the female organ’), RV.; &c.
a: सक्थि — n. [संज् --किथन् Uṇ. 3. 154] 1 The thigh; (changed in comp. to सक्थ after उत्तर, पूर्व and मृग or when the compound implies comparison; see P. V. 4. 98). --2 A bone. --3 The pole or shafts of a carriage.

k.v: सक्थि क्लीबे पुमानूरुस्तत्सन्धिः पुंसि वङ्क्षणः। गुदं त्वपानं पायुर्ना वस्तिर्नाभेरधो द्वयोः॥

m: स—कूति (स-), mfn. full of desire, enamoured, TBr.

सक See 6. स, p. 1111, col. 2.

सकंटक — a. 1 Thorny, prickly. --2 Troublesome, dangerous. --कः The aquatic plant शैवल q. v.

स—कण्ठ-रोधम् ind. in a suppressed or low voice, Bālar.
स—कण्डु or स—कण्डूक, mfn. attended with itching, Suśr.

troublesome, perilous, W.
having the hairs of the body erected, thrilled with joy or desire, Kathās.
having pointed splinters, MBh. (v.l.)
accompanied with bones (said of fish), Pat.

स—कच्छप mfn. with tortoises, Ml.

m: 1. स—कल mfn. (for 2. See s.v.) having a soft or low sound, MW.
2. स-कल mf(आ)n. (fr. 7. स + कला; for 1. स-कल See p. 1123, col. 3) consisting of parts, divisible, material (opp. to अ- and निष्-क्˚), MaitrUp.; MBh.

possessing all its component parts, complete, entire, whole, all (प्रतिज्ञां सकलां-√ कृ, ‘to fulfil one's promise’; m. [sometimes with अपि] ‘everybody’; n. ‘everything’ or ‘one's whole property’), KātyŚr.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
whole = wholesome, sound (opp. to वि-कल), Nīlak.
affected by the elements of the material world (with Śaivas applied to a soul which has not advanced beyond the lowest stage of progress), Sarvad.
paying interest, Naiṣ.
a: सकल — a. 1 Together with the parts --2 All, whole, entire, complete. --3 Having all the digits, full (as the moon); as in सकलेंदुमुखी. --4 Having a soft or low sound. --लं 1 Everything. --2 The whole. --Comp. --वर्ण a. (i. e. पद or वाक्य) having the letters क & ल, i. e. quarrelling; Nalod. 2. 14.
